title: Workspace review admission
description: Exercise static review preview through an isolated production gateway with no device slots. Proves placement, configuration and owner checks, without launching a worker.

workspace-preview.intent: Review placement preserves the authorized host without allocating a slot.

unsupported-placement.intent: Unsupported placement cannot authorize workspace review.

missing-owner.intent: A gateway without a configured native owner rejects preview without allocating resources.
